name: logos-marquee
title: Logos Marquee
description: A heading over an endless strip of logos that fades at both edges and pauses on hover. Still under reduced motion.

props.name: logos
props.description: Logos to loop. The name is read by screen readers.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Runs the loop the other way.

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Pauses while the pointer or focus is on the strip.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Stops the loop and shows the logos still.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
